description: Use this when the user wants investors in a class of one of their funds told that a distribution is coming, and those without bank details asked to add them. Starts the notices. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed notices with each investor’s addresses, for the user to confirm. This call sends nothing, creates no distribution, and Capital Company never moves money.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_send_preliminary_distribution_notices
title: Send preliminary distribution notices
